integrity: The proof independently enumerates every star facet from the published connected-subgraph theorem, projects its normal into the affine hull, derives a sharp global radius bound by summing leaf clearances and averaging all center-containing clearances, and constructs the unique equality center. All facet contacts are proved symbolically; finite linear-program replay is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns star graphs in the standard cosmological-polytope Euclidean realization. It does not assert an inradius formula for arbitrary graphs, whose connected-subgraph facet normals have more varied coefficient patterns, and it does not determine extremal ellipsoids or non-orthogonal images.
title: Every star cosmological polytope is tangential with an exact unique inball
